g.text: Learned onboarding: FiQA 0; NFCorpus / SciFact 48 wrappers,
96 components, 16 generation attempts and 8 samples per panel.
Serving uses at most one shared generation bundle per query.

g.text: The source-fixed160 choice equals each family’s target-best fixed policy. The oracle selects one cap2 policy per setting, using target labels.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53606a

g.text: Lines connect tested settings; means weight them equally. Intervals condition on these three families, source fits and panels; settings are not independent domains.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53606a

g.text: The +0.002307 macro oracle opportunity applies to these finite queries/settings and the global cap2 menu; it is not a population or query-routing bound.
